name: design-review-panel
description: Dynamic design review panel with verdicts and no fixed reviewer cap: a core trio (UX Strategist, Craft Reviewer, Motion/Polish) plus auto-drafted specialists (Deep Accessibility, Token/Theme Architect, Performance & Rendering, i18n & Adaptivity, Content & Microcopy, Data-Viz). Criteria distilled from Emil Kowalski's animation skills, Jakub Krehel's better-* suite, Paul Bakaus's Impeccable, and Vercel's Web Interface Guidelines. Exclusive scopes with ownership transfer, severity-floor escalation triggers, root-cause collapse, diff-scoped review (--diff), depth tiers (--depth), opportunity hunting (--mode=opportunities), safe auto-fixes (--apply), WCAG/APCA contrast modes, and adversarial verification (--verify). All reviewers run in parallel and produce a unified, evidence-cited report ending in a Block / Needs changes / Approve verdict.
